result.executiveDecision: Ineligible / Review Required — Multiple protocol screening lab thresholds were not met, steroid washout eligibility is unconfirmed, and protocol deviations and safety events require follow-up.
result.executiveSummary: Participant PT-1042 fails multiple protocol laboratory screening thresholds (Hemoglobin, ANC, Platelets, Creatinine, ALT, AST). Additionally, past prednisone exposure (ended 05-Aug-2026) lacks documented dose and protocol washout context. A Grade 2 nausea/vomiting AE led to a dose hold, while a Day 15 visit/CBC deviation occurred on Day 21 due to transportation issues. Several non-laboratory exclusion criteria remain unconfirmed without affirmative source documentation.

priorityFindings.title: Multiple Protocol Screening Laboratory Failures
priorityFindings.finding: Participant's screening labs fall outside protocol thresholds: Hemoglobin (10.2 g/dL vs >=12.0 g/dL), ANC (1.1 ×10⁹/L vs >=1.5 ×10⁹/L), Platelets (145 ×10⁹/L vs >=150 ×10⁹/L), Creatinine (1.4 mg/dL vs <=1.2 mg/dL), ALT (82 U/L vs <=45 U/L), and AST (76 U/L vs <=40 U/L).
priorityFindings.whyItMatters: Failing screening lab criteria impacts participant eligibility and safety to proceed on investigational protocol without specific protocol waiver or re-screening documentation.
priorityFindings.interpretation: PT-1042 does not meet hematologic, renal, or hepatic inclusion/exclusion laboratory thresholds defined in protocol-demo.pdf.

evidence.fact: Hemoglobin screening threshold: >=12.0 g/dL; ANC screening threshold: >=1.5 ×10⁹/L; Platelet screening threshold: >=150 ×10⁹/L; Creatinine screening threshold: <=1.2 mg/dL; ALT screening threshold: <=45 U/L; AST screening threshold: <=40 U/L.
Hemoglobin 10.2 g/dL; ANC 1.1 ×10⁹/L; Platelets 145 ×10⁹/L; Creatinine 1.4 mg/dL; ALT 82 U/L; AST 76 U/L.

priorityFindings.title: Unconfirmed Prednisone Washout Compliance
priorityFindings.finding: Prednisone was administered from 01-Aug-2026 through 05-Aug-2026, but the specific dose, route, and required protocol washout period are not documented.
priorityFindings.whyItMatters: Prohibited concomitant medications or insufficient steroid washout can confound safety evaluation or violate exclusion criteria.
priorityFindings.interpretation: Without documented prednisone dosage and protocol-defined steroid washout duration, eligibility regarding prohibited medications cannot be confirmed.

priorityFindings.title: Grade 2 Nausea/Vomiting Dose Hold and Ongoing Status
priorityFindings.finding: Grade 2 nausea with intermittent vomiting began 05-Aug-2026 approximately 18 hours after study treatment, leading to a temporary dose hold and oral antiemetic initiation.
priorityFindings.whyItMatters: Requires tracking of dose modification compliance, AE resolution status, expectedness, and final investigator causality determination.
priorityFindings.interpretation: Onset occurred ~18 hours post-dose showing temporal association with study drug; final causality and expectedness remain unrecorded.

evidence.fact: Grade 2 nausea with intermittent vomiting began 05-Aug-2026 approximately 18 hours after study treatment. Preliminary investigator causality was possibly related. Study dose was temporarily held and oral antiemetic therapy was initiated.

missingEvidence: Event resolution date and dose resumption details
priorityFindings.recommendedAction: Obtain updated adverse event log detailing final causality, expectedness, resolution status, and formal dose resume/hold decision.

priorityFindings.title: Out-of-Window Day 15 Visit and Delayed CBC Collection
priorityFindings.finding: Day 15 visit window was Day 13 through Day 17, but the actual visit and CBC collection occurred on Day 21 due to transportation issues.
priorityFindings.whyItMatters: Delayed safety lab collection impacts safety monitoring timelines and creates a data integrity deviation.
priorityFindings.interpretation: The Day 15 protocol visit protocol schedule was missed by 4 days beyond the late window limit (Day 17 vs Day 21).

evidence.fact: Day 15 visit window was Day 13 through Day 17; actual visit occurred Day 21. CBC was collected on Day 21 rather than within the Day 15 visit window. Transportation issues are documented as the reason.

missingEvidence: Investigator severity assessment and final data impact determination for deviation
priorityFindings.recommendedAction: Submit protocol deviation form to investigator for severity classification and impact assessment.
